answer_1.quote: ...we convert four and seven document-based NLP tasks, respectively, into a dialogue format. These NLP tasks ... include summarization, question answering, rewriting, etc....
answer_1.outputs: Multi‑turn dialogue responses evaluated on a 1–10 scale

answer_3.quote: ...we use GPT-4 to evaluate all responses, except for classification and recollection tasks... We provide GPT-4 with a zero-shot chain-of-thought to assign an integer rating from 1 to 10 based on the relevant context.

answer_4.quote: ...we recruited five graduate students to evaluate 60 randomly selected instances from each of the Follow‑up, Refinement, and Expansion tasks... The Cohen's kappa score of 0.58 indicated satisfactory agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were given the same evaluation instructions as GPT‑4, including questions about helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, depth, creativity, and adherence to constraints.
